text:
What worked: Option long trades on NIFTY hit their targets (long straddle +Rs 4,883, long breakout +Rs 2,498), and Gold 1 g long, SGMART long and JLHL short also hit targets. The company paper result for the day is -Rs 354.

What did not: Most gap-and-go and scalp trades were stopped out or timed out, and the Commodities desk lost on crude oil and natural gas. Two credit spreads were closed by the CEO at a loss. The COO notes flag no edge so far for Scalping, Commodities and Crypto desks. Paper results are not proof of an edge.

What I am changing tomorrow: Treat headline signals about routine filings and already-priced moves as doubtful, and size down gap-and-go on a falling market.

Watch tomorrow: Whether Wall Street's rebound holds, banks and metals after today's fall, and any further AI-trade weakness.
